verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents official programmatic surfaces to build against. These include the Snowpark API for Python, Java and Scala, REST APIs published as official OpenAPI specs in the snowflakedb GitHub repo so developers can generate clients in any language, and the SQL API for custom applications and integrations. The probe 404s for OpenAPI files at docs root paths do not contradict the GitHub-hosted specs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of general-purpose client SDKs/drivers (e.g. connectors) beyond Snowpark, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
